technical_decisions: BRep nguồn chân thực qua qymcad-kernel, không chạy Boolean trên mesh và gọi đó là exact CAD.
Trường hợp Box overlap: intersection=500, union=1500, difference=500 mm³; kiểm tra BRepCheck_Analyzer và phân loại non-manifold/naked edges.
Map TopoDS history Generated/Modified/Deleted qua document persistent refs. Lỗi phải abort transaction và không bỏ lại shape pointer.

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: shared split/trim geometric kernel operations
positive.expected: Build exact valid BRep; compare topology, bounding box and area/volume against independent geometry oracle, then save and reopen.

negative.setup: Use degenerate wire, null shape, zero/negative radius/height or impossible tolerance appropriate to Curve And Face Split Intersections
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: one exact planar face crossed by a straight trim line
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: two valid faces, sum of areas equals original within tolerance; split map emitted
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: tangent/coplanar overlap ambiguities and self-intersecting trim

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.
